turns.user_message: I'm vegetarian, what are my options?
turns.agent_response:
Caputo Trattoria is your best bet for a satisfying vegetarian dinner tonight. The aroma of roasted garlic and fresh basil hits you as soon as you get near their brick oven, where they are firing up some of the best pizzas on the property. They are open until 10:00 PM tonight, the vibe is casual, and no reservations are required.

Since they specialize in Italian classics, you'll find plenty of meat-free options like their signature pastas, calzones, and hand-stretched pizzas. Pro tip—if you're a fan of a little heat, ask for their house-made chili oil to drizzle over a vegetable pizza; it really elevates the flavors. Just keep in mind that hours and prices may vary, so it's always good to confirm when you arrive. After dinner, it is just a short walk over to the Wolf Den if you're in the mood for some free live entertainment.

Are you staying with us at the hotel, or just stopping by for the evening?

turns.user_message: What about for a group dinner with friends?
turns.agent_response:
For a fun group vibe, SolToro Taqueria & Tequila Bar in the Casino of the Earth is fantastic. The energy there is lively, the decor is colorful, and it is a perfect spot to pass around some drinks and shared plates. 

Since you are looking for vegetarian options, their modern Mexican menu is incredibly easy to customize. You can easily build a great meal out of fresh guacamole, roasted vegetable tacos, and authentic sides, while the rest of your group can explore everything else. They also boast an extensive tequila and mezcal selection that groups always love to dive into. They are open until 10:00 PM tonight, and it's a casual spot so you do not even need reservations, though I always suggest groups arrive a little early to grab a good table. Just keep in mind that hours and prices can vary, so you'll want to double-check when you walk up.

If you all want to keep the energy up after dinner, novelle is an upscale lounge nearby where you can grab some craft cocktails and listen to a DJ. 

How many friends are joining you for dinner tonight?

turns.user_message: Someone suggested the steakhouse, is that OK for me?
turns.agent_response:
Absolutely. Michael Jordan's Steak House is a fantastic choice for a group celebration, and you will actually have a wonderful meal there as a vegetarian. 

Pro tip—upscale steakhouses are surprisingly great for vegetarians because their side dishes are truly decadent. While your friends go for the prime cuts, you can build an incredible meal out of their legendary sides, like perfectly roasted asparagus, rich salads, and massive baked potatoes. The chefs there are also very accommodating and can usually put together a beautiful, off-menu seasonal vegetable plate for you. 

It has an elegant, upscale vibe with some cool sports memorabilia, right in the Casino of the Sky. They are open tonight until 10:00 PM, and they do suggest business casual attire. Just a heads up that menus and hours can occasionally vary, so it is always good to check with the host stand when you arrive. 

Since reservations are highly recommended for Michael Jordan's, how many people are in your party tonight so we can figure out what kind of table you will need?
